Package com.nexuslink.protocol.http.rest

Class RestRequest

java.lang.Object
com.nexuslink.protocol.http.rest.RestRequest
public final class RestRequest extends Object
Mutable builder-style model for a REST request. Held by the UI and handed to RestExecutionService for execution.

    • interpolated

      public RestRequest interpolated(UnaryOperator<String> fn)
      Returns a deep copy of this request with every string field passed through fn, used to resolve ${VAR} references at send time without mutating the editor's bound model. The UI keeps the templated request (so history/replay stay parameterised); only the executed copy carries resolved values.
